SELECT * FROM( SELECT ROW_NUMBER()OVER(PARTITION BY AI_INPT_USER_ENO ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ID DESC) AS ORDERR, AI_INPT_USER_ID, AI_INPT_AUT_CD, AI_INPT_USER_FA_RE_YN, AI_INPT_USER_ENO, AI_INPT_USER_NM, AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO, AI_INPT_USER_YN, AI_INPT_MGPE_YN, AI_INPT_USER_RGS_DTM, AI_INPT_USER_END_DTM, LST_DB_CHG_ID, TRN_LOG_SRNO, LST_DB_CHG_DTM, AI_INPT_SRVC_USER_DSCD, (SELECT AI_INPT_CMN_CD_NM FROM CSPD112TI WHERE AI_INPT_GRP_CD = '120' AND AI_INPT_CMN_CD = A.AI_INPT_AUT_CD) AS AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL, (SELECT AI_INPT_USER_NM FROM CSPD101TI WHERE AI_INPT_USER_ENO = A.AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS AI_INPT_SNPE_NM FROM CSPD101TI A WHERE 1=1
)C WHERE C.ORDERR = '1'

ORDER BY DECODE(AI_INPT_USER_AUT_VAL, 'QA', 1, 'S2', 2, 3)
ORDER BY AI_INPT_MGPE_YN
ORDER BY AI_INPT_MGPE_YN DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ID
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ID DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_NM
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_NM DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO
ORDER BY AI_INPT_SNPE_ENO DESC
ORDER BY AI_INPT_USER_ID ASC
